issues.question: Does Charter s. 12 protect a corporation from cruel and unusual treatment or punishment?

answer_groups.answer: No; s. 12 protects human beings, not corporations.

answer_evidence_quotes: Simply put, the text “cruel and unusual” denotes protection that “only human beings can enjoy”
Since it cannot be said that corporations have an interest that falls within the purpose of the guarantee, they do not fall within s. 12’s scope.
the protection offered by s. 12 does not extend to corporations
